target_universe.rationale: DERIVED has zero TRAIN rows under the frozen split; it cannot be used to fit/tune a learned next-update model without violating chronology.

causal_state.source_visibility: For a target update in block B, DATA-004 source state may use only source rows from blocks strictly less than B.
causal_state.target_baseline: Previous block-complete direct target probability for the same SIG market.
causal_state.outcome: Current block-complete direct target probability; this is the next observed direct repricing event, not a resolved election outcome.

LOO_PRICE.exclusion: Accepted DATA-003 direct mapping market IDs only. Other v2 echoes remain visible.

LOO_FAMILY_STRICT.purpose: Robustness test removing all exact-structural v2 sources in addition to the semantic family exclusions.

features.source: Last block-prior p_yes states; freshness-weighted and unweighted aggregates by R2.5 relationship class and mathematical class.

models.tuning: alpha in [0.1,1,10,100] on chronological inner-TRAIN validation

primary_metric: DEV MAE improvement versus same-row persistence baseline (previous direct probability).
secondary_metrics: directional accuracy at 0.5c and 1c model dislocation thresholds
coverage by event and SIG market
uncertainty: Deterministic SIG-market cluster bootstrap, 400 resamples, on per-event absolute-error improvement.
selection: Among gate-passing candidates, maximize the cluster-bootstrap 95% lower bound of MAE improvement. Freeze one champion and at most two challengers before FINAL.
stop_rule: If no LOO-FAMILY candidate passes, classify R3 as no confirmed independent structural next-update signal and do not open FINAL.
final_policy: No FINAL target rows or performance may be loaded/evaluated in discovery code.
